A1-01.atk: a small imp flings a rolled contract like a dart: a quick paper flutter, a thin hiss through the air, then a sharp pinprick punch that pierces through with a dry tick
A1-01.def: no armour, it flinches: a soft cloth-and-flesh bump, a rattle of loose parchment scrolls in its satchel, one faint ink drip on stone

A1-02.atk: a fast swish of silk-like darkness snatches at the foe, a quick tearing rip as a shadow is peeled away, then a light, sly tap and a vanishing hiss
A1-02.def: no real block, it dodges: a puff of smoke dissolving, soft light footfalls skittering sideways, the blow only whooshing through empty air

A1-04.ko: 핏잉크 붓 휘갈김 · 팔 얼얼히 맞음
A1-04.atk: a quill scratches fast on parchment, a wet splatter of thick ink flicks outward, then ink hits like a sharp slap with a sizzling hiss as it stains
A1-04.def: it takes the blow on a bare arm: a soft wet smack, a paper-and-bone rustle, then slow ink droplets dripping onto a stone desk

A1-05.ko: 뒷골목 주먹과 돌 · 누더기가 퍽 맞음
A1-05.atk: a scrappy back-alley lunge: ragged cloth flapping, a rough scuffle of boots on cobbles, then a dull knuckle thud and a cracked bottle clink
A1-05.def: patched rags offer nothing, it stumbles back: a muffled thump on burlap, boots scraping gravel, a coin or two jingling from its pocket

A1-06.ko: 촛불 꺼지며 저주 쏘아냄 · 가볍게 움찔
A1-06.atk: a tiny angry snarl, a string of candle flames snuffing out one by one with soft pffts, then a thin whistling hex bolt pops against the target with a fizzing sting
A1-06.def: it squeals and flinches, small and light: a thin cloth thud, a hissing puff of dark smoke, tiny hurried footsteps skipping back

A1-07.ko: 그림자가 목 감고 칼 스침 · 어둠 속으로 비켜남
A1-07.atk: a ribbon of shadow whips around with a silky swish, tightens with a creak, then a quick steel slice shings through with a thin wet cut
A1-07.def: it melts sideways into the dark: a cloak flutter, a feather-light step, the dagger glancing with a short scrape of metal

A1-08.ko: 저울 낙인 손바닥 · 피 맺힌 손으로 막음
A1-08.atk: a palm slaps down branded with a glowing scale mark: a hot sizzle of searing skin, a short heavy drip of blood, then a firm smack that rings like a stamped seal
A1-08.def: it raises a bloodied hand: a wet clap against the blow, a small glassy blood-ward shimmer, then drops pattering onto the ground

A1-09.ko: 약탈품 자루 휘둘러 퍽 · 노획 갑옷이 덜걱
A1-09.atk: a rough lunge with a clanking sack of looted junk swung like a flail: loose coins and scrap rattling, a whoosh, then a clumsy crunching thump
A1-09.def: patchwork looted plates knock together: a clattering of mismatched metal, a hollow dented clank, a few coins spilling and rolling away

A1-11.ko: 마족 장검 내리침 · 투박한 갑옷이 둔탁히 받음
A1-11.atk: a rasping demon grunt as a crude iron blade is hauled up, a heavy downward whoosh, then a solid metallic chop with a short sting of sparks
A1-11.def: a plain iron breastplate takes it: a dull metallic bong, leather straps creaking, a low guttural huff as it digs its boots into dirt

A1-13.ko: 장부 줄긋듯 도끼 관통 · 두꺼운 가죽이 둔하게 받음
A1-13.atk: a ledger page tears with a dry rip, then a heavy headsman's axe whistles down and punches clean through with a deep wet chunk and a ringing blade scrape
A1-13.def: a thick leather hood and apron swallow the hit: a heavy muffled thud, a creak of stiff hide, the axe handle knocking wood on stone

A1-15.ko: 빛 삼키는 칼날 · 검은 칼등으로 흘림
A1-15.atk: a long pull of drawing steel, then a blade that swallows sound: a low suction hiss as it sweeps and a thin dull slice that dies quickly instead of ringing
A1-15.def: the black blade turns the strike aside: a quiet grinding scrape, light sucked into silence, a short low metal moan fading to nothing

A1-17.ko: 그림자 왕의 전언 · 목소리 잃은 몸이 흐릿하게 맞음
A1-17.atk: a muffled low bell is struck once beneath cloth, a hollow rush of wind-like shadow carries forward, then a soft heavy shove lands with a reversed hiss
A1-17.def: its hollow body absorbs the blow: a deep padded thud, a faint ghostly rustle of heavy robes, a long breathy sigh of air draining away

A1-18.ko: 무대 위 커다란 칼날 · 두꺼운 앞치마로 막음
A1-18.atk: a curtain rope creaks, a heavy cleaver whooshes through stage dust, then a meaty chop splits a wooden board with a sharp wet crack and a hollow echo
A1-18.def: a stiff blood-stained apron takes it: a leathery slap, a clank of hanging hooks swaying, a wood plank groaning under its boots

A1-21.ko: 제단 위 핏잔 쏟음 · 의식 종 울려 막음
A1-21.atk: a chalice tips and thick blood glugs onto an altar stone, a low muffled bell tolls once, then a heavy crimson surge slams out with a wet thump
A1-21.def: a ritual bell rings out against the strike: a deep brass clang, blood drops splashing on a stone altar, a dim ward humming as it fades

A1-23.ko: 낫이 서명만 남기고 베어냄 · 낫자루로 받아냄
A1-23.atk: a long scythe drags with a rasping scrape, then sweeps in a wide arc with a heavy swish, and a clean reaping cut ends in a papery rustle of a single page
A1-23.def: the scythe shaft blocks across its body: a hard wood-and-iron knock, a rattling of paper scraps in its coat, a long tired creak

A1-24.ko: 조건서 내밀고 가는 칼 찌름 · 칼날로 쳐냄
A1-24.atk: a rolled terms scroll is slapped into a palm, a thin rapier hisses from its sheath, then a lightning-fast thrust stings with a bright metallic snick
A1-24.def: a quick parry with a rapier: two sharp steel rings, a boot pivot scuffing on stone, a taut breath-like whoosh as it slips back

A1-25.ko: 장막 문 빗장 내려침 · 문짝 같은 방패로 막음
A1-25.atk: a heavy iron gate-bar groans up, then a long halberd shaft sweeps through the hanging veil with a cloth whoosh and ends in a deep iron thunk
A1-25.def: a slab of a shield swings across: a low door-like boom, hinges creaking, a curtain of dark fabric rippling and settling after

A1-27.ko: 문서고 열쇠 돌려 피 창 꿰뚫음 · 피 막이 퍼짐
A1-27.atk: a heavy key turns in a rusty vault lock, drawers slam, then a spear of congealed blood shrieks through the air and punches through with a thick wet bore-through
A1-27.def: a curtain of blood falls like a sheet: a wide wet slap, slow thick dripping, a deep soft thud as the hit is smothered in crimson

A1-28.ko: 계약서 찢는 마력 · 갈라진 몸이 쿵
A1-28.atk: a thick parchment rips apart in slow tearing stages, a sharp magical snap cracks the air, then a ragged shock lands with a wet sting as if paying half back
A1-28.def: its big body shudders: a heavy thud, a crackle of tearing paper ghosts, a dark sizzling spark as the backlash bites it back

A1-29.ko: 등불 꺼뜨리며 걷는 거구 · 두터운 그림자 살갗
A1-29.atk: a heavy stomp, a row of lanterns blowing out with soft clicks, then a deep darkness slams in with a bone-shaking boom and a long sinking rumble
A1-29.def: a rippling shadow hide absorbs the blow: a deep booming thud, wings flapping heavily, a low resonant groan rolling out

A1-30.ko: 감긴 눈의 일섬 · 칼등이 침묵 속에 받음
A1-30.atk: complete stillness, then a single razor draw: a hair-thin whistle of steel and a clean crack of a cut that leaves a ringing quiet behind it
A1-30.def: a straight blade held vertical meets the strike: a deep dense steel ring-out, a long sustained vibrating overtone, then dead silence

A1-31.ko: 잔 부딪히고 핏빛 칼 관통 · 우아한 장막이 막음
A1-31.atk: crystal goblets clink, a thin rapier of dark red steel rings out, then a refined, clean pierce runs through with a short wet pop and a silk-like trail
A1-31.def: a velvet cloak swirls in front: a heavy cloth whump, a glass goblet shattering, a thick blood-ward pulse humming under the fabric

A1-32.ko: 군단 행군 저주 퍼부음 · 저주 갑주가 막음
A1-32.atk: marching hobnailed boots in unison thud, countless muffled low rattles of cursed armour, then a wide spreading hex wave rolls out and crashes with a creeping sizzle
A1-32.def: heavy cursed armour clanks: a deep metallic thud, chain mail shivering, a sickly dark hiss as withering dust sifts off its plates

A1-34.ko: 대가 징수의 철퇴 · 쇠사슬 묶인 몸이 받아냄
A1-34.atk: a heavy chain drags and is swung overhead with a groaning whirl, then a spiked iron weight lands with a bone-deep crunch and a cold clank of settling links
A1-34.def: coiled chains wound across its chest take the hit: a loud rattling clang, a deep dense thud, links swaying and jingling to rest

A1-35.ko: 악몽의 발톱과 울림 · 연기 몸이 흩어졌다 뭉침
A1-35.atk: a distorted reversed swell rises under a low demon growl, shadowy claws whip with a ragged swish, then a dark magic burst cracks with a hissing, crawling aftershock
A1-35.def: its smoky body bursts apart: a soft whoomph, whispering air spreading outward, then smoke slowly knitting back with a gentle pulse

A1-41.ko: 칼 없이 묶인 채 · 계약이 가시로 되받음
A1-41.atk: it only sways, bound hands rattling a little chain: a faint link clink, a low nervous shuffle, a shivering paper rustle with no real strike
A1-41.def: a gaunt body in shackles stands firm as a wall: a thick dull thud, then a sharp snap as invisible contract thorns bite back, chain links jangling

A1-42.ko: 흑요석 갑주 쿵 · 검은 돌이 깊게 울림
A1-42.atk: a slow heavy shoulder-shove of stone armour: grinding obsidian plates, a deep scrape across flagstones, then a weighty shield-bash thud with a tiny glassy crack
A1-42.def: obsidian plate rings: a deep glassy bong, a brittle splinter-like crackle running through the stone, then long dense echoing silence

A1-43.ko: 결계 천 온몸에 엮임 · 결계가 충격을 삼킴
A1-43.atk: a ripple of woven shadow lifts like a heavy curtain, a slow droning swell pushes forward, then a soft broad shove that spreads with a whispery hiss
A1-43.def: a vast web of shadow veil swallows the impact whole: a deep sucking boom, the sound dissolving into a long falling reversed hiss, a wide silent hush

SP-A1.ko: 그림자 끊기며 연쇄 마력 · 그림자 없는 몸이 삼킴
SP-A1.atk: a taut tearing sound as a shadow is cut loose from a body, then three rapid rising dark-magic detonations, each deeper than the last, with cracking obsidian and a vast reversed swell
SP-A1.def: no shadow to hit, the blow passes through: a hollow thump of nothing, a soaring wind-like draw, a deep cracked-glass shiver as the strike is swallowed entirely

UN-A1.ko: 피 서약 낙인 베기 · 피 문양 방패
UN-A1.atk: a blade is drawn across a palm, blood drips onto parchment, a hot brand hisses, then a heavy slash cuts and leaves a sizzling stamp-like thud behind
UN-A1.def: glowing blood sigils flare in a circle: a thick humming ward, the strike smacking into it with a wet slap and a ringing seal-like clink

UN-A1-7.ko: 영혼 뽑는 낫 · 영혼 종 울려 막음
UN-A1-7.atk: a hooked blade slips in with a low ghostly draw, a long suction pulls a wisp out with a hollow pop, then a stiff paper folds and snaps shut in a closing palm
UN-A1-7.def: a small cracked bell tolls dully inside its ribs: a hollow chime, a rattling of folded parchment, a soft rush of stolen souls swirling around it

EP-A1-1.atk: curtain fabric swishes, bare feet pivot on boards, twin dark blades whirl with a rising whistling spin, then a sharp crack of a critical cut and the fall of a heavy stage curtain
EP-A1-1.def: it spins away: a rapid sequence of skimming blade scrapes, silk ribbons snapping, a light airy hiss, one clear short steel ring as it lands

EP-A1-2.ko: 도열 쓰러뜨리는 연쇄 · 처형 갑옷 둔중하게 받음
EP-A1-2.atk: a heavy executioner's sword hauled in a wide whistling arc, a first ringing hit, a second deeper hit, a third wet crunch, each followed by a toppling thud and a dark magic hiss
EP-A1-2.def: thick black execution plate: a loud dense clang, hooded cloak heavy with sound, a long metal ring-out and a stubborn deep creak

EP-A1-3.atk: a heavy curtain of shadow is parted with a long cloth whoosh, slow steps echo, then three chained heavy cuts crash down with dark shimmering ring-outs
EP-A1-3.def: a veil of shadow sheaths it: the strike sinks into a thick draping fabric with a deep muffled boom, a soft protective hum washing over like a held breath

PN-A1-C1.atk: a dripping dagger flicks off blood with a snap, a quick slashing whoosh follows, then a wet slice lands and a slow patter of blood drops keeps falling
PN-A1-C1.def: a bleeding hand parries too late: a sharp skin-wet cut, steady drips patting on stone, a faint wound-open sizzle that will not close

PN-A1-C2.ko: 협곡 바닥 그림자 올라옴 · 엷어지며 흩어짐
PN-A1-C2.atk: a deep rumble climbs from the canyon floor, a rubbery shadow tendril whips out with a stretched whoosh, then pierces cleanly with a quiet dry stab and an echo down the rift
PN-A1-C2.def: light rakes it and it thins: a papery tearing hiss, a hollow echo bouncing off canyon walls, faint dripping that never stops

PN-A1-C3.ko: 정해진 만큼만 휘두름 · 쇠사슬에 묶인 거구
PN-A1-C3.atk: huge chained arms haul back with a taut grinding groan of links, then swing exactly once with a steady heavy whoosh and one deep, precisely measured thud
PN-A1-C3.def: thick locked shackles hold its stance: a dull clanking of chain, an immovable heavy thud, links stiffening with a single taut twang

PN-A1-U1.ko: 피 먹인 검 맹세 · 검이 맹세로 막음
PN-A1-U1.atk: a blade is wiped with blood and rings softly, then a straight resolute thrust whistles forward and pierces with a clear bright wet ring
PN-A1-U1.def: it holds its sword upright and the blade rings out against the strike: a bright steady steel clang, a low grounded stance of boots, a little blood spatter

PN-A1-U2.ko: 저울 동전 짤랑 · 동전 궤짝이 받음
PN-A1-U2.atk: a heavy coin pouch jingles and hits a scale pan, a hand slaps down a ledger, then a long tally spike pierces with a dull metal stab and a stack of coins clinking
PN-A1-U2.def: an iron-banded coin chest on its arm takes the blow: a deep solid wooden bong, coins shifting, a stubborn slow creak of lock hinges

PN-A1-R.ko: 계약서 한 줄 남김 · 계약 인장이 막음
PN-A1-R.atk: a folded contract is snapped open, a thin dark blade slides out, then a precise critical slash with a bright crack leaves one last breath-like hiss
PN-A1-R.def: a blood-stamped contract held up like a shield: a papery shield-like slap, a hot seal sizzling, a wound-open drip that keeps tapping

PN-A1-E.ko: 두고 온 것을 찾는 연쇄 · 비어있는 몸이 무너짐
PN-A1-E.atk: a low reversed swell opens like a curtain, two deep dark-magic strikes land in a double-hit chain, each trailed by an empty hollow echo like something missing and a lingering drip
PN-A1-E.def: its hollow torso rings like an empty vessel: a resonant boom, a slow draining hiss, a patter of blood that never seems to heal

UP-A1-09.ko: 약탈대장 깃발과 칼 · 전리품 갑옷 겹겹이
UP-A1-09.atk: a banner snaps in a gust, looted metal clatters, then a spiked war cleaver whips down with a heavy chop that clanks against a pile of plunder
UP-A1-09.def: layers of stolen armour clatter: a thick tiered clanging, a dented shield boom, a clinking cascade of loot coins falling

UP-A1-11.ko: 선봉 군기 돌격 · 겹쳐 입은 갑주 쿵
UP-A1-11.atk: a short war horn-like grunt, thudding boots charge, then a heavy double-handed sword hews with a wide whistle and a punishing iron slam
UP-A1-11.def: a double layer of iron plate rings: a loud deep metal slam, a heavy shield-bash grunt, boots skidding and holding

UP-A1-15.ko: 세 번 우는 칼 · 녹여 벼린 쇠가 울림
UP-A1-15.atk: a molten-metal hiss, a thick blade wails three times with rising metal shrieks through the air, then a heavy cut that swallows light with a deep suction thud
UP-A1-15.def: a melted-together blade rings thrice: a deep layered metal moan, a long dark echo, a final dull hush as the force is swallowed

UP-A1-18.ko: 그림자를 끌고 오는 광폭 · 그림자 천이 무겁게 감쌈
UP-A1-18.atk: a long dragging scrape of a shadow trailing behind, a savage cleaver swish, then a heavy wet crush followed by the shadow slapping down like a thick sheet
UP-A1-18.def: a heavy trailing cloak of dark sheets wraps it: a deep cloth-heavy thud, a dragging rustle, a thick dark hiss rippling away

UP-A1-23.ko: 쌓인 계약서 위 대낫 · 서류더미가 충격 삼킴
UP-A1-23.atk: a vast pile of papers shifts and rustles, a huge scythe sweeps with a low sonorous whoosh, then a reaping cut and a flurry of pages burst up with a long papery cascade
UP-A1-23.def: waist-deep paper stacks swallow the strike: a muffled giant paper thump, sliding avalanche of pages, scythe shaft knocking with a hollow wooden clunk

MA-01.ko: 손목 그어 피 칼날 두 번
MA-01.cast: a wrist is cut with a fine slice, blood streams into the air and hardens into sharp blades with a glassy crystalline ring, then two fast whistling slashes land with wet cracks on the front line

MA-04.cast: a glowing iron brand hisses in the dark, then presses against metal armour with a searing sizzle and a long thinning groan as the steel buckles like paper behind the lines

SA1-01.cast: blood droplets pattering into a swirling ring, a thick red ward blooms with a rising protective hum and a seal-like clack, then settles to a thin humming skin around the front line

SA1-02.cast: the ground-bound shadow rustles, giant dark hands rise with a stretched creaking pull, then close with a slow squeezing crunch and a strained, tightening leather creak

MA-05.ko: 피 얹어 가장 무거운 자 들림
MA-05.cast: blood drips onto a metal scale pan with a clink, the beam creaks and tilts, then the heavy side is hoisted away with a chain-hoist rattle and a final deep boom

MC-05.cast: a cold breathy draft spreads slowly with a creeping hiss, armour plates groan as they grow heavier, then knees buckle in a row of dull thuds in front

SA1-04.cast: a wound opens with a short wet split, blood flies in a dark spiralling boomerang loop with a reversed swell, then smacks the front line in a double sharp hit

MA-09.cast: a blood drop falls into a bell-shaped well, a distant muffled toll answers once, then a spreading shockwave of dark pressure rolls across the whole field with a long rumble

SA1-06.cast: a slow dark sweep wipes away a bright hum, brand sizzles hit many shields at once, then metal shields clatter and drop with a hopeless cascading clank

MA-16.ko: 피 한 잔 나눠 마시고 힘 솟음
MA-16.cast: many cups clink together, a thick blood gulp, then a rising swell of dark energy builds under heavy breathing, ending in a roaring surge that crackles through every weapon

RA1-1.cast: a single deep bell tolls, a heavy parchment is stamped with a thud, then a total silence swells and everything collapses at once in one enormous cracking boom with a long dying rumble

NA1-1.cast: a shadow stretches along the floor like torn ribbon, a sly snatch rustles and pulls the card across with a papery drag, then a soft fabric flick and a closing fist of dark

HA1-1.cast: a quick friendly clap of hands, a soft rustle of parchment slipped from a sleeve, a cloth sliding swap, then a tiny coin-like tick and a smooth card flip

HA1-2.cast: a fingertip brushes a card with a faint dry scratch, a thin dark spark fizzles into it, and a sinking wheeze creeps outward with a dry rasping hiss

HA1-3.cast: a single cough starts a faint dark ripple that fans out with a growing creeping hiss across canvas tents, cloth sagging and blades dulling with soft heavy clanks

US-A1-1.ko: 피 한 방울에 목숨 둘 내려감
US-A1-1.cast: a single blood drop lands on a vast brass scale with a muted ring, the beam sways in total silence, then two heavy weights crash down with deep dull thuds and a long hush

PS-A1-1.cast: a draining reversed sucking whoosh pulls glowing strands out of two foes, a paper-thin tearing, then the stolen energy pours into an ally with a warm swelling thrum

PS-A1-2.cast: heavy iron manacles swing with a rattle, snap shut with a loud clamp and a click of a lock, then a long taut chain groan as the foe is dragged still

RS-A1-1.cast: blood is pulled from a hand into a dark spear with a thick congealing squelch and a crystalline ring, then it launches with a hard whistle and runs through its target with a deep wet impact

RS-A1-2.cast: a dark veil unfurls with a heavy cloth whoosh, a long sucking drain pulls from the front line, then a soft heartbeat-like pulse thrums as the ally swells with borrowed strength

RS-A1-3.ko: 피 한 방울이 접시 전체를 가볍게
RS-A1-3.cast: a single blood drop hits a scale pan with a bright tick, a spreading dark ripple makes armour groan, then many small crunching thuds roll across the enemy ranks

US-A1-2.cast: a thin parchment unrolls with a brittle crackle, a pen-scratch burns a mark, then a sharp strike hits a foe while a surging dark swell rises behind the allies with a sharp metallic crack

CS-A1.ko: 피 한 방울이 마법 입을 막음
CS-A1.cast: a single blood drop falls with a tiny splat, a closing spell is crushed to a dead hush with a sucking click, then a heavy cold strike thuds into the strongest foe

I2-3.equip: a dagger slides from a sleeve with a silk whisper, a tiny sharp clip locks it to a belt, then one quick test throw whistles and sticks into wood with a twang

IA1-1.equip: a thumb is pricked, blood drips on a small parchment charm, the paper is pressed with a wet stamp, and it settles with a faint warm hum and a thin brass clink

IA1-2.equip: a glassy dagger is slid into a sheath with a smooth click, a faint tick of stone on leather, then a single flex that flicks with a brittle ring and a tiny crack

IA1-3.equip: a rag doll is stuffed with a dry rustle of hair, a needle pricks through cloth with a small pop, then a tiny shrill creaking squeak of thread rings on every poke

IA1-4.equip: a hollow mask lifts with a hollow porcelain knock, slips over a face with a leather strap snap, and the room's sound is sucked to a hush with a reversed hiss

S3-1.equip: a heavy metal seal is pressed into hot wax with a wet crunch and sizzle, a warm low pulse closes over, and a heavy brass clink settles with a soft healing hum

IA1-5.equip: a heavy old scroll unrolls with a long dry crackle, a quill scratches in blood, a wax seal thuds, and a deep rising shimmer of piercing dark magic hums beneath

SR-A1.equip: a colossal greatsword is drawn from a stone scabbard with a long grinding steel scrape, a deep resonant ring-out echoes, and the hilt locks with a heavy clack under a shimmering verdict-like hum

IR-A1.equip: a leather-strapped bone mask tightens with a creak and a buckle snap, a faint wet pulse of veins throbs under it, and a thin whistling edge hums as it settles

PI-A1.equip: a heavy iron weight is lifted off a scale with a chain clank, the beam springs with a sudden twang, and the weight is gripped with a deep dull thud and a lingering low drone

TK-A1-1.ko: 생명 받고 튀어나온 악마 · 그을린 몸이 퍽
TK-A1-1.atk: a small spark pops, a hot brimstone hiss, a short growl, then wiry claws rake the air with a quick scratchy whoosh and a bite-sized hit
TK-A1-1.def: a scorched little body takes it: a soft leathery thump, a puff of ember smoke, a quick yelp-free hiss as it hops back
